title: Example 141: lookupswitch bisection rewritten half-open proved equal to the closed form on sorted tables by the own checker
description: Regression proof of Mica's LookupSwitch#find rewritten half-open (example 046's form) against the closed form, within the scope of strictly sorted tables stated with a \forall over the array in --unchanged-unless, by the tool's own checker (approach.engine native): expected verified. Arrays of primitives are in the checker's fragment since this example, a cell per index up to --max-array-length (8); the library's run took 2.3 s over 88 paths and 1044 solver calls. JBMC proved the same harness in 101 s and 2 GB.
